title: Gold
body:
Description

Gold can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate, Darkslate, Limestone, Blackstone, Lavaslate, Prismarine and very rarely Sandstone nodes.

Note: Gold will not spawn in Marble deposits as of update 1.67.0.

The raw form of Gold takes on a darker yellow color that could be easily mistaken for Pyrite.

Putting Gold in a refinery raises the sell price to $38/stud. Putting that refined Gold through a forge further increases the price to $42/stud.

Trivia

  • During testing, Pyrite and Gold were nearly indistinguishable, as all of the ores at that time did not have special node meshes.
